name: com.whichappwins/trialground
title: Trialground
description: Find public agent trials and evidence-backed tool recommendations for specific tasks.

tools.name: list_trials
tools.description: List neutral public task briefs and blind tester links as of the catalog timestamp. When untested_only is true, return community tasks with no report in that snapshot, oldest first.

tools.name: find_working_tool
tools.description: Find a dated, evidence-backed public tool route for a task. Returns the tested scope and fallback when available, or an explicit no-match when the catalog lacks evidence.
